# Default gates

## The table

| Tier | Rule | Action ids |
|---|---|---|
| free | Do it and mention it | `read-things`, `write-notes` |
| notice | One line before acting | `push-draft` |
| ok | The CEO's explicit OK | `ship-it`, `file-or-sign`, `no-meaning-action` |

## Actions in plain language

| Action id | Meaning | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `read-things` | Read and search | look something up |
| `write-notes` | Edit files in the working tree | update the notes |
| `push-draft` | Push a draft branch | push a branch that publishes nothing |
| `ship-it` | Release something | release a new version |
| `file-or-sign` | Sign anything binding | sign a contract |

## Principles

1. Not a table.
